venue.name: Chick-fil-A College Football Hall of Fame
venue.mapsQuery: College Football Hall of Fame, 250 Marietta Street NW, Atlanta, GA 30313

events.title: Football Fest & Free Day
events.offerCopy: RSVP helps us plan capacity for games, giveaways, and exhibit access. One household RSVP covers your group.
events.details: A full day of free Hall admission, family games on the plaza, and rotating exhibit access. Arrive before 11 AM for the shortest lines at the skills zone.
events.expect: Face-painting, inflatable games, and volunteer-led tours of the Hall. Food trucks on Marietta Street (pay separately).
events.gettingThere: 250 Marietta St. NW. Weekend parking is usually available in nearby decks. MARTA: Dome / GWCC / Philips Arena / CNN Center.

faqs.a: No — this day is free with RSVP. We use the count to staff games and exhibits.
Yes. Use # Attending for everyone in your party, including kids.

events.title: Gameday Kickoff Party
events.offerCopy: Join us for food, music, and full Hall access before the game. General admission includes museum entry all day. Members save $4 at checkout.
events.details: Every Saturday in October, 10:00 AM–5:00 PM at the Hall. Ticket includes plaza programming plus museum admission the same day.
events.expect: Live music on the plaza, food vendors, and full access to the Hall exhibits. Saturday mornings fill quickly — come early.
agenda: 12:00 PM — Hall exhibits at your pace
events.gettingThere: Paid parking in nearby decks. MARTA: Dome/GWCC/Philips Arena/CNN. Check Falcons or campus game-day street closures before you leave.

faqs.q: What is included with my ticket?
faqs.a: General admission plus Hall access during the event window. Food and merch are extra.
Yes — every Saturday in October. Pick a date at checkout.
Nearby paid decks; see Getting There for transit notes.

events.title: Ascension: Rise of the QB
events.offerCopy: Timed entry tickets include full Hall access. Add the exhibition to your visit at checkout.
events.details: A special exhibition on the modern quarterback — film, artifacts, and interactive throws. Opens September 5 during regular museum hours.
events.expect: Allow 45–60 minutes in the gallery plus time for the rest of the Hall. Photography is welcome without flash.
agenda: Last gallery entry 45 minutes before close
events.gettingThere: Same as a regular Hall visit: 250 Marietta St. NW. Combine with general admission.

faqs.a: Exhibition access is bundled with timed Hall admission at checkout.
Yes — choose a visit date so we can manage gallery capacity.

events.title: Community Film Night
events.offerCopy: Free admission — RSVP helps us plan seating in the Hall theater. Doors at 5:45 PM.
events.details: A free community screening in the Hall theater, followed by a short conversation with guest panelists.
events.expect: Theater seating is first-come for RSVPs. Light refreshments in the lobby. The Hall exhibits close at 5 PM; film night is a separate evening program.
events.gettingThere: 250 Marietta St. NW. Evening parking is typically available in nearby decks.

faqs.a: No — RSVP only. We hold a seat count for the theater.
Yes. Include them in # Attending, up to 4+.

events.title: Legendary Saturday
events.offerCopy: Autographs, photos, and insider stories from College Football Hall of Famers. Limited capacity — purchase early.
events.details: A ticketed afternoon with inductee appearances, a moderated conversation, and a signing line. Hall admission is included.
events.expect: Bring a small item to sign. Professional photos are available for purchase. Lines move in timed groups.
events.gettingThere: 250 Marietta St. NW. Allow extra time — this program often sells out the plaza.

faqs.a: We run timed groups so as many guests as possible meet the legends. Time is limited.
Yes — your ticket covers the program and same-day museum access.

events.title: Kids Game Day
events.offerCopy: Free for kids 12 and under with a paid adult Hall ticket. Tell us how many are in your group so we can staff the skills zone.
events.details: Youth-focused stations on the plaza: throwing, agility, and flag-football games led by Hall educators.
events.expect: Kids 12 and under need an accompanying adult. Closed-toe shoes recommended. Water stations on site.
events.gettingThere: Plaza entrance on Marietta Street. Strollers OK; limited storage inside.

faqs.a: The kids program is free with RSVP. Adults need regular Hall admission unless they are members.
Best for ages 5–12. Younger kids are welcome with a parent in the play area.

events.title: Hall of Fame Talks
events.offerCopy: Intimate Q&A with inductees and historians. RSVP required — seating is limited in the theater.
events.details: An evening conversation tying the current exhibition to living history. Theater seating only.
events.expect: Doors 6:30 PM. Talks run about 70 minutes with Q&A. Books and exhibit access after the program.
events.gettingThere: Use the evening theater entrance. Nearby decks are the easiest parking after 6 PM.

faqs.a: No — free with RSVP. Unclaimed seats may be released 10 minutes after start.
Clips may appear on Hall channels. The live Q&A is in-person only.

events.title: Members Appreciation
events.offerCopy: Annual thank-you for members: early exhibit access, refreshments, and a behind-the-scenes tour. RSVP with your membership email.
events.details: Members-only twilight hours with a curator walk-through and a toast in the lobby.
events.expect: Bring your membership card or the email on the account. Guests of members: note them in # Attending (max 2 guests).
events.gettingThere: After-hours entrance on Marietta Street. Staff will scan membership at the door.

faqs.a: Current members plus up to two guests listed on your RSVP.
Renew online before the event; bring the confirmation email.
